title: Cornerstone · Grade 2 — Mathematics Assessment, Set B (15 Questions)
_note: Entered 2026-09-20 from the printed page. Its ladder runs Foundational, Easy, Medium, Hard, Conceptual, Applied — the same shape as the Grade 3 baseline. items.question: In your own words, explain why we "carry" a number when adding two numbers.
Akanksha added 48 + 27 and wrote 65. Is he correct? If not, find his mistake and write the correct answer.
There are 45 mangoes in a basket. 12 are eaten, and then 8 more mangoes are added. How many mangoes are there now?
A vendor has 3 boxes with 6 apples in each box, plus 2 more apples kept separately. How many apples does he have in total?
